title: sys_user_position's record title is the raw user id plus the position machine name in Setup's User Positions list, record page and audit log
body:
qa#2 · os-bob · session_012dn2Acf5wtyrf2yKWCThBj

QA-source: #32102 · ux-conventions.labels-over-machine-names · acceptance[1]

Found by the QA run #32102 (subject `ff04ad81`).

## Reproduction (stock showcase, admin)

1. Open `/_console/apps/com.objectstack.setup/sys_user_position`. The Title column reads `v34DfZXycmuAzUro8kwhiHrFNRR5WXDR → showcase_exec`, while the columns beside it read User "Dev Admin" and Position "Executive".
2. Bind a member to a position: `POST /api/v1/data/sys_user_position {"user_id": ID, "position": "showcase_contributor", "organization_id": ORG}`.
3. Open `/_console/apps/com.objectstack.setup/sys_audit_log`. The Create row's Record cell reads `ID → showcase_contributor`, and the record page H1 reads the same.

Reproduced on 2 fresh loads.

**Expected:** a person's name and the position label, for example "QA Member S2 → Contributor". `GET /api/v1/meta/position/showcase_contributor` has label "Contributor".

## Mechanism

- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/sys-user-position.object.ts`: `display_title` is ``Field.formula({ … expression: F`record.user_id + ' → ' + record.position` })``, and it is the object's `displayNameField`.
- `sys-security-assignment-display-title.test.ts` pins this text, so the fix must re-pin it.
- `sys_presence` in service-realtime has the same `record.user_id + …` pattern. It did not appear in the UI during this run.

Owning package: `@objectstack/plugin-security`.
